notes: Summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics + in-app guidance). Trying Hosted API for 6-week trial; now evaluating move to Dedicated for predictable latency and cost.
Trial timeline: trial started 2025-11-01 (hosted API), initial integration via SDK + streaming; POC front-end A/B tested on 10% of users.
POC results (observed): avg QPS during trial windows 18-35 QPS, peak sustained bursts ~60 QPS for 30s, avg concurrency measured 12, peak concurrency 28.
Token mix (measured): 72% short-turn completions (<128 tokens avg), 18% embeddings calls (batching used, avg 256 tokens), 10% long-context / summarization (avg 900 tokens).
Monthly token consumption (trial extrapolated): 65M tokens/month currently. Product roadmap expects 4-6x growth in 12 months -> forecast 260M-400M tokens/month.
Latency requirements: product SLO 95th < 400ms for short completions; embeddings/semantic-search can be async but desire batch latency < 1s. Reranking target p95 < 250ms.
Desired Dedicated sizing (initial ask): capacity to support 150 QPS sustained with ability to absorb 2x burst (300 QPS) for short prompts; concurrency safety cap 400 active streams across pool.
Suggested HW profile discussed: pool equivalent to 4 x A100-80GB nodes (or H100 equiv) with automatic horizontal scaling for peak windows; separate embedding pool optimized for batching.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market procurement wants committed monthly price +/- 10% elasticity. Willing to commit to 12-mo if unit economics below $0.003/token for short completions (target).

Security: require VPC peering, SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, customer-managed KMS for keys, and contractual data residency in NA. Security team requested Redwood security FAQ and architecture diagram (drive links above).
